scenario_results.name: Orders Service CrashLoopBackOff Missing Config
scenario_results.query: Orders service is crashing on startup with CrashLoopBackOff.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Pod orders-service-1 is crashing on startup in CrashLoopBackOff due to a missing environment variable or configuration error.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Verify required environment variables (e.g. DB_PASSWORD, SECRET_KEY) in Secret/ConfigMap, correct missing keys, and restart rollout.

scenario_results.name: Payments Service OOMKilled Memory Limit
scenario_results.query: Payments service was terminated with exit code 137.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Pod payments-service-1 was OOMKilled (exit code 137) after exceeding its configured memory limit.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Increase container memory limit in deployment manifest (e.g. `limits.memory: 512Mi`) and verify application memory leak buffers.

scenario_results.name: Orders Service ImagePullBackOff Bad Tag
scenario_results.query: New orders deployment cannot start due to ImagePullBackOff.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Pod orders-service-1 cannot start due to ImagePullBackOff (invalid or non-existent image tag).
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Correct the invalid container image tag in deployment or rollback to the previous known good revision: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/<service>`.

scenario_results.name: Payments Service Bad DB Host Resolution
scenario_results.query: Checkout returning 500 errors on payments endpoint.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Service is failing with 500 errors because DB_HOST is invalid or PostgreSQL is unreachable.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Correct DB_HOST in the service ConfigMap to point to the active internal PostgreSQL Service ('postgres') and trigger a rollout restart.

scenario_results.name: Inventory Service Redis Connection Refused
scenario_results.query: Inventory service failing stock reservation calls.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Inventory service is experiencing failures because Redis connection was refused on port 6379.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Verify REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT configuration, confirm the redis pod is running, and restore network connectivity.

scenario_results.name: Orders Service Readiness Probe HTTP 500
scenario_results.query: Orders pod unready 0/1; readiness probe failing.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Pod orders-service-1 is failing readiness probe checks on /health/ and has been removed from service endpoints.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Investigate failing /health/ probe endpoint dependencies and verify the probe port matches the container listening port.

scenario_results.name: Payments Service Downstream Timeout 504
scenario_results.query: Payments API returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout on inventory call.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Service is returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout due to downstream dependency call latency exceeding timeout window.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Increase DOWNSTREAM_TIMEOUT window in ConfigMap and scale downstream service replicas to mitigate request queuing.

scenario_results.name: Inventory Service CPU Limit Throttling
scenario_results.query: Inventory service throttled under peak load with elevated response latency.
scenario_results.root_cause_diagnosed: Service is suffering high latency and throttling due to container CPU limit configuration.
scenario_results.suggested_fix: Inspect failing pod logs, verify environment variables and database connectivity, and restart rollout if needed.

scenario_results.name: Jenkins CI Build Unit Test Failure
